summary: Implemented iteration `authenticated-dashboard-shell`. Added protected `/dashboard` routing with Auth.js session enforcement, dashboard as the post-login and post-registration target, Home as the default content with user-name welcome fallback, collapsible left navigation with Home/Feedback Request/Configure, protected placeholder pages for Feedback Request and Configure, top-right user identity, Auth.js logout returning to `/`, and an icon-only persisted light/dark theme toggle. Verification passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs` with 17/17 passing. Browser verification, Playwright, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and production build were not run per task constraints and are not claimed as passed.
